clue.text: Landing area publicises tour

parts.note: to air views is to make them public, so publicises gives airs
a trip is a journey or tour

explanation.surface: An airport press office announcing a holiday tour.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of cleared ground where light aircraft touch down is an airfield, a landing area.

clue.text: Church to go in a year? That's hurtful

indicators.note: the church abbreviation is placed inside the other pieces

explanation.surface: Asking whether churchgoing once a year is painful.
explanation.definitionFit: Something aching hurts; achy means sore or painful, hurtful in the physical sense.

clue.text: Polish back of grey stone

parts.note: to rub is to polish

indicators.note: the last letter of grey is taken

explanation.surface: Shining the rear of a grey stone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruby is a precious red gemstone.

clue.text: Note parasite waltzing into social events

parts.note: te is a note in tonic sol-fa

explanation.surface: A sponger dancing his way into society gatherings.
explanation.definitionFit: Afternoon gatherings over cups and cakes are social events.

clue.text: Part of boot marching men should keep

definitions.meaning: the arched middle of the foot, covered by that part of a boot
soldiers on parade should stay in time together

explanation.surface: Soldiers' footwear and drill discipline.
explanation.definitionFit: The arched top of the foot, and the shoe part over it; read as two words it means keeping time.

clue.text: Intend article to be taken in by people

indicators.note: the article is held inside the word for people

parts.note: men are people
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone planning for a product to be bought by the public.
explanation.definitionFit: To intend something is to mean to do it, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Peer over colourless drink

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: an earl is a peer of the realm
grey means dull, colourless

explanation.surface: A lord frowning over a dull glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A bergamot-scented black tea is a drink.

clue.text: Relatively helpful employer?

parts.note: relatively means in favour of relatives: a boss who hires family

explanation.definitionFit: Someone practising nepotism favours relations, especially when handing out jobs.

clue.text: Jewish scholar's undergarment taken in robbery

indicators.note: the garment is held within the word for a robbery

parts.note: a heist is a robbery
a bra is an undergarment

explanation.surface: A learned man's underwear stolen in a burglary.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is short for 'is', linking definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialist in the Hebrew language and its texts is a Jewish scholar of that tongue.

clue.text: Support for power

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Backing given in exchange for political power.
explanation.definitionFit: A prop is a beam or post that holds something up, a support.

clue.text: Silent pair, slithering, could be snakes

indicators.note: moving like a snake, the letters wriggle into a new order

explanation.surface: Two quiet creatures sliding along, perhaps serpents.
explanation.definitionFit: Snakes are an example of reptiles, so they could be described thus.

clue.text: What boxer must do before bout for someone unimportant

definitions.text: What boxer must do before bout
definitions.meaning: a boxer has to come within the weight limit for his division at the weigh-in
a person included only to fill out numbers

explanation.surface: A boxer's pre-fight weigh-in, with a jab at a nobody.
explanation.definitionFit: A makeweight is a minor item or person added only to make up a total, so of little importance.

clue.text: Have team collecting right sort of supermarket goods

parts.note: to own is to have

indicators.note: the group gathers the abbreviation within it

parts.note: a band is a group or team

explanation.surface: A shopping team gathering the right groceries.
explanation.definitionFit: A store's own label products are a type of supermarket goods.

clue.text: Desire, just in a promiscuous way

parts.note: want means desire
only means just, merely

explanation.surface: Lust alone driving loose behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting wantonly means acting with sexual looseness, without restraint.

clue.text: Anger about one apparition

indicators.note: the word for anger goes around the numeral

parts.note: wrath is great anger
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Fury at seeing a ghost.
explanation.definitionFit: A wraith is a ghost or spectral figure, an apparition.

clue.text: Parents, heading off for rest

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for parents is removed

parts.note: mothers are parents

explanation.surface: Mum and Dad leaving for a lie-down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rest' looks like a verb about sleeping but is the noun meaning the remainder.
explanation.definitionFit: The rest, meaning the remaining people, are the others.

clue.text: Woman I cheer madly

indicators.note: wildly, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A fan cheering a woman wildly.
explanation.definitionFit: Cherie is a female first name, so a woman, a crossword convention.

clue.text: Some say wife's improved by a little beer

parts.note: better means improved
a half is a half pint of beer in a British pub

explanation.surface: A husband claiming his wife becomes nicer after a small drink.
explanation.walkthrough: In a British pub 'a half' is half a pint. 'Some say' marks the definition as a fond way of naming a wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Better half is a jocular idiom for one's spouse, especially a wife.

clue.text: Singe map, losing southernmost part

indicators.note: in a down entry the bottom letter of the word for map is dropped

parts.note: a chart is a map

explanation.surface: Burning off the bottom of a map.
explanation.definitionFit: To char is to scorch the surface, to singe.

clue.text: Poke piano with stick

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano
a rod is a stick

explanation.surface: Jabbing a piano with a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: To prod is to jab or poke.

clue.text: Unsightly condition Isaac Newton bears

indicators.note: the scientist's name carries the letters within it

explanation.surface: Newton suffering from a blemish problem.
explanation.definitionFit: A skin complaint of pimples and spots is an unsightly condition.

clue.text: Quietly make contact with extremely eager lecturer

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
to reach someone is to contact them

indicators.note: the outermost letters of eager are taken

explanation.surface: Softly getting in touch with a keen academic.
explanation.definitionFit: A preacher delivers sermons, lecturing a congregation; lecturer in the sense of moraliser.

clue.text: Periods of stunned confusion for audience

indicators.note: the word is said aloud to listeners

parts.note: a daze is a state of stunned bewilderment

explanation.surface: Spells of dazed bewilderment while performing for a crowd.
explanation.definitionFit: Days are spans of time, periods, as in the old days.

clue.text: Certain to tuck into alcoholic drink, but restrained

indicators.note: the word for certain goes inside the drink

parts.note: mead is an alcoholic drink of fermented honey
sure means certain

explanation.surface: A drinker sure of enjoying a tipple, yet holding back.
explanation.definitionFit: Measured speech or behaviour is careful and moderate, so restrained.
